acceptance.statement: This report binds 40 current static source-audit artifacts, their hash-bound v2 machine-inventory evidence, and 29/29 applicable work-only Adobe Animate authoring-structure audits. It creates no migration.json binding. The Animate audits are not authoring acceptance, shipped-SWF execution, FLA/SWF equivalence, authoritative original-runtime evidence, final specification, implementation authorization, fidelity or audio acceptance, human/owner review, or strict migration completion.
